snippet.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4: Episode Metal (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
This is a playthrough of the Episode Metal "lock-on" content from Sonic the Hedgehog 4: Episode I and Episode II.

Set some time after CD, this bonus chapter shows Metal Sonic in the lead-up to the events of Episode II. You can access it by having both Episode I and Episode II installed, and it's essentially just a hard mode of the Episode I levels.
